caseName: Sturgeon v. Great Lakes Steel Corp.
caseNameFull: Sturgeon v. Great Lakes Steel Corp. On petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit and Florida ex rel. Laing v. Scott, Sheriff. On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Florida
attorneys: Messrs. M. C. Harrison and Homer Marshman for petitioners in No. 582, and Mr. Wm. W. Flournoy for petitioner in No. 598.

opinions.text: Petitions fop writs of certiorari denied for the reason that applications therefor were not made within the time provided by law. § 8 (a), Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 940), 28 U. S. C., § 350.
